santa-monica-ca.name: Santa Monica
santa-monica-ca.blurb: Beach-city homes on small lots, where ADUs and smart remodels make the most of every square foot.

westlake-village-ca.name: Westlake Village
westlake-village-ca.blurb: Lake homes from the 1970s and '80s, larger North Ranch houses, and twenty neighborhoods with active HOAs.

santa-clarita-ca.name: Santa Clarita
santa-clarita-ca.blurb: Family homes across the Santa Clarita Valley, from Valencia to Saugus.

culver-city-ca.name: Culver City
culver-city-ca.blurb: Bungalows and post-war homes in Sunkist Park, Carlson Park and Fox Hills, most with compact kitchens.

pacific-palisades-ca.name: Pacific Palisades
pacific-palisades-ca.blurb: Rebuilding after the January 2025 fire, and updating the homes in The Highlands and Huntington Palisades that came through it.

calabasas-ca.name: Calabasas
calabasas-ca.blurb: 1980s and '90s homes in The Oaks and Calabasas Hills, many with builder-grade kitchens.

beverly-hills-ca.name: Beverly Hills
beverly-hills-ca.blurb: Condo kitchens south of Wilshire to fully custom kitchens in the Flats and Trousdale Estates.

malibu-ca.name: Malibu
malibu-ca.blurb: Coastal homes where salt air, Coastal Commission review and ocean views shape every remodel.

los-angeles-ca.name: Los Angeles
los-angeles-ca.blurb: From Los Feliz duplexes to Sherman Oaks ranches.

monterey-county-ca.name: Monterey County
monterey-county-ca.blurb: Private, game-managed ranch land in southern Monterey County: wild pig, blacktail deer, turkey and more.

iowa-city-ia.name: Iowa City
iowa-city-ia.blurb: Hail, straight-line winds, ice dams and hard water: home services priced for Eastern Iowa.

iowa.name: Iowa
iowa.blurb: Statewide picks for Iowa businesses, from Des Moines to Cedar Rapids, Iowa City and the Quad Cities.
